method: Normal training UI with native HITBOXES; ordinary keyboard movement closes the gap, followed by ordinary light input. No actor, position, health, guard, camera or clock injection. Auto-heal and free meter disabled.
limits: Historical humanoid hurtbox stays versus adaptation; source collision and original-game scale are not certified.
Static candidate and grounded versus contact do not establish 1:1 timing or animation.
Standing guard is tested separately from crouching guard.
